propositions: Base-query loop iterates all projects in a single flat loop without per-project error isolation, causing one project's transport failure to abort the entire reconciliation pass for all projects
A single mapped project with nonexistent key (e.g. LEG) generates ACLI error 1, propagating out and aborting scheduled reconcile passes across all projects
Enrichment loop already implements per-project fail-open resilience; base-query loop must inherit equivalent isolation to ensure transport failures degrade only affected project

New _fetch_project helper must drain both base queries (active + done-recent) into local dict, merge atomically to snapshot only on success, emit fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert on error, and continue other projects
Per-project transport error isolation must preserve fail-closed behavior for syntactically invalid keys via _validate_project_key and re-raise BackendPaginationStallError to surface truncated reads
Single-project path must remain regression-identical and never write empty all-deletions snapshots on fetch failure
